product_overview: Backend API to support property and booking operations, authentication, housekeeping and deposit workflows, and an integration endpoint for Channex webhooks. Provides clear success/error responses and endpoints for client UIs and integrations.
core_goals: Provide secure authentication and current-user endpoints to support client applications and automation.
Support property operations (housekeeping, check-in/check-out, service charges, pre-checkout) and booking deposit lifecycle with reliable APIs.
Expose a robust webhook endpoint for Channex to receive and process booking and inventory events.
Return clear, consistent success and error responses so clients can implement resilient flows and validation handling.
Enable notification delivery and audit/current-user retrieval for UI workflows and administrative automation.

features.name: Authentication and User Management
features.description: Endpoints and flows for user login, token handling, and retrieving the current logged-in user; supports client login screens and token-protected routes.
user_flows: Navigate to /auth -> Fill email input field -> Fill password input field -> Click login button to submit -> Client calls POST /api/login -> Receive 200 response with auth token -> Store auth token in client -> Navigate to / -> Call GET /api/current-user with Authorization token -> Receive 200 response with user details -> See dashboard at /

Navigate to /auth -> Fill email input field -> Fill password input field with incorrect password -> Click login button to submit -> Client calls POST /api/login -> Receive 401 Unauthorized -> See error message indicating invalid credentials -> Remain on /auth
Navigate to / -> Send request with expired or malformed token -> Server responds 401 Unauthorized to GET /api/current-user -> Redirected to /auth -> See token expired or invalid token error message

features.name: Property and Booking Management
features.description: APIs and UI flows for viewing and managing stays, bookings, housekeeping assignments, and creating booking deposits; includes search, filters, CRUD and check-in/check-out operations.
user_flows: Navigate to /bookings -> View booking list -> Use search input to filter by guest or date -> Click on a booking item -> Navigate to /bookings/:id -> View room lines and charges -> Click Edit booking -> Update fields -> Submit changes -> Client calls PATCH/PUT /api/bookings/:id -> Receive 200 OK -> See updated booking details on /bookings/:id

Navigate to /bookings -> Click on a booking item -> Navigate to /bookings/:id -> Click Edit booking -> Enter invalid dates or missing required fields -> Submit changes -> Client calls PATCH/PUT /api/bookings/:id -> Receive 400 Bad Request -> See validation error messages on /bookings/:id

Navigate to /stays -> View active stays list -> Filter by status and date -> Select a stay -> Click Perform check-in -> Client calls PATCH /api/stays/:id to update status -> Receive 200 OK -> See stay status changed to 'checked-in' in list

Navigate to /stays -> View active stays list -> Select a stay -> Click Perform check-out -> Client calls PATCH /api/stays/:id to update status -> Receive 200 OK -> See stay removed from active stays list or status set to 'checked-out'
Call GET /api/housekeeping with Authorization token -> Receive 200 response with list of housekeeping assignments -> See assignment details including property and assignee
Call GET /api/housekeeping without Authorization token -> Receive 401 Unauthorized -> See authentication required error

Navigate to /bookings -> Click on a booking item -> Navigate to /bookings/:id -> Click 'Create deposit' -> Fill deposit amount -> Click submit -> Client calls POST /api/deposits with booking id and amount -> Receive 201 Created with deposit id -> See deposit creation confirmed in booking detail

Navigate to /bookings -> Click on a booking item -> Navigate to /bookings/:id -> Click 'Create deposit' -> Fill deposit amount with missing/invalid booking id -> Click submit -> Client calls POST /api/deposits -> Receive 400 Bad Request or 404 Not Found -> See error describing invalid booking reference

features.name: External Integrations (Channex Webhook)
features.description: Webhook endpoint to receive Channex booking and inventory events, validate payload/signature, and persist or update system state; returns clear HTTP status codes for integrators.
user_flows: Receive POST /api/channex/webhook with valid payload and signature -> Validate payload schema and signature -> Persist or update booking/inventory state -> Respond 200 OK -> Emit processing log or notification

Receive POST /api/channex/webhook with malformed JSON or missing required fields -> Attempt to validate payload -> Fail validation -> Respond 400 Bad Request -> Log validation error and return error details to caller

Receive POST /api/channex/webhook with invalid signature or untrusted source -> Validate signature -> Detect invalid/untrusted signature -> Respond 401 Unauthorized -> Reject request and log security event

known_limitations.issue: Race condition in cash_outs - check-then-act pattern allows overpayment
known_limitations.impact: Two simultaneous cash outs could exceed the approved payment amount

known_limitations.issue: Settlement operations not wrapped in database transaction
known_limitations.impact: Partial settlement could create orphan records

known_limitations.issue: Cancelled bookings do not reverse revenue entries
known_limitations.impact: P&L reports may be inaccurate after cancellations
